residency.note: Time-based residency: final semester in residence at Abu Dhabi (in-absentia considered only within 8 credits of graduation). No fixed credit-residency floor; double-majors need >=30 distinct credits each.

creditCaps.label: Post-matriculation transfer credit (max 8/semester on leave, 8/summer, 20 career)
Online course credits (inferred CAS default; NYUAD bulletin silent)
NYUAD awards no AP/IB/exam advanced-standing credit

exceptions: Available only beginning in the second year of study
Electives only — major, minor, and Core courses (incl. E, Q, X, J, Colloquium) cannot be taken P/F
First attempt in any Core area must be letter-graded
A P/F course cannot satisfy a prerequisite
J-Term and summer courses may not be taken P/F

transferCreditLimits.note: Transfer credit is awarded only for coursework taken AFTER matriculation at NYUAD; no transfer credit for pre-matriculation or high-school work, and none for AP/IB/A-Level exams. Up to 8 credits per semester while on approved leave and up to 8 credits per summer, to a career total of no more than 20. firstYearMaxTotal=0 reflects the no-pre-matriculation rule (inferred framing of the CAS first-year field).

overloadRequirements.note: First-year students (from their second semester) need a cumulative internal GPA >= 3.7 to overload above 18 credits
Second-year students need a cumulative internal GPA >= 3.6 to overload
Third- and fourth-year students need a cumulative internal GPA >= 3.5 to overload; no student may exceed 20 credit hours, and overloads are not possible in J-Terms or summer sessions
